_doc: Posting-quality rules. max_age_days: filter out postings whose ORIGINAL date (earliest of LinkedIn date, LinkedIn-id estimate, ATS first_published) is older than this. repost_days: flag a posting as a repost when LinkedIn's date is this many days after the original. exclude_companies: case-insensitive substrings of company names never worth applying to (gig / AI-training / freelance marketplaces). skip_title_pattern: titles never fetched or evaluated. board_*: which board postings become candidates.
